name: wrong_spec_gear
about: The server scores this character's gear for Holy (WEIGHTS), and the character just put on the Filigreed Shadow Circlet: a Shadow item, a fair upgrade for Shadow and next to nothing for Holy.
goals: Reach level 40 without wasting time, and know what to fix.

truth.expected: Scored for Holy, the worn Filigreed Shadow Circlet is a weak head piece: the gear advice's best head upgrades are the Embalmed Shroud, the Earthen Silk Hood and the Electromagnetic Gigaflux Reactivator. A right analysis points the head slot at one of those and never tells the player to get or keep a Shadow head item.

must_find.about: a kept action names one of the three best head upgrades for the configured spec

must_not_claim.about: an action that tells the player to get or keep a Shadow head item
the circlet called an upgrade or a good pick
